changes: UE 5.8 CSV fields up to 64 MiB are accepted.
Aggregate RHI/DrawCalls is prioritized over per-pass DrawCall columns.
Shader autogen header generation is reported separately from measured shader compile work.

causes: The authored replacement Landscape is not visibly readable in candidate C01 through C05.
Candidate C04 removes the baseline brown inland mass and shows only ocean, sky, and a beach wedge.
Landscape LOD and shader-complexity diagnostics are byte-identical to corresponding lit captures.

offline_capture_diagnosis.camera: Serialized transforms are exact, but the harness does not verify frustum intersection or Landscape pixel coverage before acceptance.
offline_capture_diagnosis.landscape_or_material: Serialized checks prove actor, components, transform, and material binding but omit render visibility, hidden-in-game state, registration, scene-proxy/render-state readiness, bounds, material relevance, and visible pixel coverage.
offline_capture_diagnosis.diagnostics: Viewport console view modes do not configure SceneCaptureComponent2D show flags; diagnostic equality proves the commands were ineffective for two captures.
